verdict.rationale: Kubernetes deployment via an official Helm chart or operator is a fair question for a vector and full-text search engine, so the axis applies. The evidence only says turbopuffer offers multi-tenant, single-tenant or BYOC deployments, with no Helm chart, operator or Kubernetes install path documented. A BYOC option is an adjacent deployment mode, not the requested capability.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can deploy to production on Kubernetes with an official Helm chart or operator
